baseline.policy: Hold cash, SPY, or QQQ at the identical 4000 USD notional over each row's identical next-open-to-tenth-session-close window; retain current cash/no-new-entry behavior.

execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: None; no short or leveraged instrument.
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: No capital is allocated; the probe cannot exceed settled ledger rows.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Gross fixed-4000-USD replacement-value diagnostics; no new cost assumption.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Only already-settled rows with canonical OHLCV prices are read.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Observer first-seen precedes next-session-open entry; settlement ends at H10.

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The price prior treats mapped equities as already reflecting public headlines, while the fixed bundle claims incomplete transmission across private entities, policy, infrastructure, healthcare, and crypto resolves over ten sessions.

independent_evidence.provenance: Prospectively logged observer rows under the unchanged source manifest; current-cohort values remain inaccessible until start.

market_prior.provenance: Decision-time entry prices and same-notional cash, SPY, and QQQ H10 opportunity-cost comparators.

transmission.catalyst: A public headline matched by one of the six frozen entity/theme queries and joined to the fixed public-equity map before the next regular-session open.
transmission.expected_direction: Broadly positive replacement value versus cash, SPY, and QQQ, with at least four of six query groups positive versus both ETFs.
transmission.half_life: Exactly ten trading sessions from next regular-session open.

candidate.falsifier: Reject unless there are at least 250 settled rows and exactly six query groups; row means versus cash, SPY, and QQQ are all positive; all three row medians are nonnegative; observed-date means versus all three comparators are positive; at least four query groups are positive versus both SPY and QQQ; maximum positive-cash query share is at most 60%; and maximum positive-cash ticker share is at most 40%. Any failure rejects, with no slice or retune.
candidate.hypothesis: With 114541 settled rows, versus 73275 at exp-20260729-006 and the frozen 109913 reopen bar, the unchanged six-query entity/theme news bundle may now show broad H10 replacement value versus cash, SPY, and QQQ; no query, ticker map, horizon, notional, threshold, response, ranking, sizing, exit, order, paper, or live behavior may change.
candidate.replacement_value_comparator: Same-notional, same-window cash, SPY, and QQQ holds for every row.
candidate.title: Fixed entity-theme bundle Axis-C attribution at 114541 settled rows

treatment.policy: Re-evaluate only the exact fixed source bundle on the newly matured settled cohort.

candidate.why_not_arbitraged: This is an attribution-only observer with imperfect search-vintage provenance, heterogeneous relevance, repeated headlines, and coarse private-entity-to-public-equity mappings. Prior reads failed benchmark-relative breadth and no capital is allocated.

decision.rationale: All four roles find a coherent thematic transmission mechanism and no numerical source conflict above the declared tolerance, while explicitly retaining research-PIT, mapping, horizon, and concentration limitations. This is only a lead submission; D0-D3, dynamic in-flight novelty, and Gate logic retain full authority.

researchability.basis: Official company, regulatory, legislative, and procurement sources establish real economic channels across representative themes, and prospectively logged rows provide a frozen research-PIT cohort.
limitations: Google News search vintages are not proven immutable canonical PIT.
The fixed mapping is coarse, often omits direct counterparties, mixes beneficiaries and competitors, and has no issuer-mention, polarity, relation-strength, or freshness gate.
Financial cross-checks cover representative issuers rather than all thirty tickers.

business_analyst.conclusion: Theme-level business mechanisms are plausible, but issuer attribution is noisy. The fixed observer copies every matched item across each query's full ticker basket without an issuer-mention, sign, relation-strength, or freshness check, so this remains a thematic association lead rather than causal issuer evidence.

evidence.claim: Rocket Lab reports both launch services and spacecraft/systems operations, supporting a space-sector channel, but its diversified model does not make all six mapped space names a common-sign SpaceX proxy.

OpenAI's Stargate announcement names Arm, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Oracle, SoftBank, and MGX, validating AI infrastructure demand while showing that the frozen public-equity map includes indirect proxies and omits several direct counterparties.

BIS rescinded the AI Diffusion Rule before compliance and announced different targeted controls, showing that a fixed export-control headline map can become stale or reverse scope across products and countries.
FDA shortage and compounding-policy changes create real GLP-1 economics but can have opposite signs for branded manufacturers and adjacent access or compounding businesses in the same fixed basket.

business_analyst.uncertainty: Official sources support mechanism plausibility, not article-level relevance, common return direction, or a ten-session causal effect. Relationship maps and search results can age while the frozen contract cannot be retuned.

financial_analyst.conclusion: Representative issuers have material financial exposure to AI capex/export controls, GLP-1 demand/pricing/capacity, and data-center power demand/cost channels. This supports mechanism plausibility only and does not establish H10 alpha or causal news attribution.

evidence.claim: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Data Center revenue was $75.246B of $81.615B total revenue, or 92.196%; hyperscale revenue was $37.869B, while no Data Center Hopper products shipped to China versus $4.6B in Q1 FY2026.
NVIDIA's issuer release independently rounds Data Center revenue to $75.2B and total revenue to $81.6B; the Data Center difference from the SEC exact value is 0.061%, below the 1% mismatch threshold.

Lilly Q1 2026 Mounjaro and Zepbound revenue totaled $12.822B, or 64.761% of $19.799B total revenue; demand, realized price, manufacturing expansion, and capex are therefore financially material GLP-1 channels.
Reuters independently reported Mounjaro at $8.7B and Zepbound at $4.16B; differences versus SEC exact values are 0.439% and 0.000%, both below 1%.

Eaton Q1 2026 net sales rose 17% with 10% organic growth; Electrical Global backlog reached $3.162B from $1.832B while commodity and wage inflation reduced segment margin by 470 basis points, showing both data-center demand and cost channels.

financial_analyst.uncertainty: Only NVDA, LLY, and ETN were sampled. Eaton lacks a standalone GAAP data-center revenue line, and financial exposure is necessary but insufficient for an H10 attribution edge.

industry_researcher.conclusion: All six themes have real industry links, but direct versus indirect exposure, competition, substitution, and sign differ materially across mapped tickers. H10 is an announcement-diffusion attribution horizon, not a cash-flow realization horizon.

evidence.claim: Stargate spans land, power, construction, and equipment over four years, validating broad infrastructure transmission while making a ten-session window a headline-diffusion test rather than realized-order measurement.
The BIS rescission and replacement-guidance process confirms semiconductor policy exposure while also showing rapid public dissemination and potentially reversing product or country scope.

The GENIUS Act focuses on payment-stablecoin issuers, reserves, custody, disclosures, and supervision, so economics differ across exchanges, brokers, bitcoin ETFs, treasury holders, and miners in the same frozen crypto basket.

The Space Force launch award splits anticipated missions among SpaceX, ULA, and Blue Origin over multi-year ordering and launch windows, so SpaceX headlines transmit mainly through competition or sector read-through rather than common near-term cash flows for the six mapped names.

industry_researcher.uncertainty: Primary sources establish pathways, not abnormal-return magnitude or decay. The queries mix positive and negative semantics, and rapid-pricing judgments are mechanism inferences rather than outcome evidence.

risk_assessor.conclusion: This is a legally reopened but high-risk attribution probe: five prior same-face reads did not establish broad benchmark-relative value, the news archive is research_pit rather than canonical_pit, and mapping noise, duplicated headlines, factor exposure, and concentration can dominate. Current execution remains cash/no-new-entry and no order can result from the card.

evidence.claim: The registered readiness surface reports entity_theme_axis_c at 114541 settled rows versus a 109913 threshold and 73275 prior baseline; this is the only ready lane and supplies the sole Axis-C novelty claim.

The frozen source surface classifies entity-theme news as research_pit with known_future_leakage=false but explicitly says Google News/current-search retrieval is not proven immutable as-published historical PIT; positive attribution is capped at observed_only.

The canonical history freezes entity_theme_news_source_bundle_forward_value after exp-20260729-006 and permits reopening only at 109913 rows, canonical PIT news, or richer independent relation evidence; no retune is authorized.
Current position control has ok_to_add_control_pass=false, so the research card cannot create an executable addition even if the attribution result is positive.

The frozen observer manifest maps each broad query to four to seven tickers spanning direct suppliers, customers, competitors, ETFs, miners, and diversified primes, creating structural sign and concentration risk.

risk_assessor.uncertainty: No current replacement-value direction was read. The main unresolved risks are duplicated or stale headlines, no canonical as-published vintage, heterogeneous signs, benchmark/factor confounding, repeated-ticker weighting, and gross rather than executable economics.

subject.research_question: Can the unchanged fixed six-query research-PIT entity/theme relation bundle, now at the machine-declared Axis-C reopen count, justify one read-only H10 replacement-value attribution test without any retune?
